round: # Story 10: Mina's day (a girl of nine tells it
picture: woman's voice). Language up to unit 10. Three questions; the right choice is not always the first.

say_en: Good morning! My name is Mina. I am nine. I get up at six o'clock.
show_en: I get up at six o'clock.

say_en: What time is it? Look at the clock.
show_en: What time is it?
wrong_say_fa: دوباره ساعت را ببین. مینا ساعت شش از خواب می‌خیزد.

say_en: I wash my face and I brush my teeth.
show_en: I wash my face and I brush my teeth.

say_en: This is my family. I eat breakfast. I eat bread and I drink tea.
show_en: I eat bread and I drink tea.

say_en: I drink tea. Point to the tea.
show_en: Point to the tea.
wrong_say_fa: این چای نیست. مینا چای می‌نوشد. دوباره انتخاب کن.

say_en: It is seven o'clock. Today is Monday. I go to school.
show_en: Today is Monday. I go to school.

say_en: This is my school. I am happy. Good morning, teacher!
show_en: Good morning, teacher!

say_en: In the afternoon I go home. I play.
show_en: In the afternoon I go home.

say_en: Look at the sun. Is it night?
show_en: Is it night?
wrong_say_fa: نه، شب نیست. آفتاب در آسمان است. حالا بعد از چاشت است.

say_en: In the evening I eat dinner. At nine o'clock I go to bed. Good night!
show_en: At nine o'clock I go to bed. Good night!

picture: man's voice; the questions are asked by the woman's voice). Language up to unit 12c: clothes
say_en: weather
m: Good morning! It is winter. Look! Snow! Everything is white.
show_en: It is winter. Look! Snow!

say_en: f: What season is it?
show_en: What season is it?
wrong_say_fa: نه. همه جا برف است. حالا زمستان است.

say_en: m: It is cold. I put on my warm coat, my hat and my shoes.
show_en: I put on my warm coat.

say_en: f: What does Hamid put on?
show_en: What does Hamid put on?
wrong_say_fa: نه. هوا سرد است. حمید بالاپوش گرم می‌پوشد.

say_en: m: This is my father. We are on the roof. We clean the roof.
show_en: We are on the roof.

say_en: f: Where are Hamid and his father?
show_en: Where are they?
wrong_say_fa: دوباره ببین. حمید و پدرش بالای بام هستند.

say_en: m: In the afternoon I play with my sister. We make a snowman!
show_en: We make a snowman!

say_en: m: Now my hands are cold. I sit next to the stove and I drink hot tea. Goodbye!
show_en: I drink hot tea. Goodbye!

round: # Story 14: Hamid's Friday (a boy of eleven tells it
picture: man's voice; the questions are asked by the woman's voice). Language up to unit 14.

say_en: m: Hello! My name is Hamid. I am eleven. Today is Friday. On Friday I don't go to school.
show_en: Today is Friday. I don't go to school.

say_en: f: Today is Friday. Does Hamid go to school today?
show_en: Does Hamid go to school today?
wrong_say_fa: امروز جمعه است. حمید روز جمعه به مکتب نمی‌رود.

say_en: m: On Friday I help my family. I carry water.
show_en: I help my family. I carry water.

say_en: f: What does Hamid carry?
show_en: What does Hamid carry?
wrong_say_fa: حمید این را نمی‌برد. او آب می‌آورد. دوباره انتخاب کن.

say_en: m: This is my mother. She cooks every day. I like bread!
show_en: She cooks every day.

say_en: m: This is my father. He works at home today. I help my father.
show_en: He works at home today. I help my father.

say_en: m: In the afternoon I play with my friends.
show_en: In the afternoon I play with my friends.

say_en: f: Does Hamid play in the afternoon?
show_en: Does Hamid play in the afternoon?
wrong_say_fa: دوباره گوش کن. حمید بعد از چاشت با دوستانش بازی می‌کند.

say_en: m: Now it is night. I go to bed. Tomorrow is Saturday. Tomorrow I go to school. Good night!
show_en: Tomorrow is Saturday. Tomorrow I go to school.

picture: woman's voice; the questions are asked by the man's voice). Language up to unit 20: clothes
say_en: where
show_en: on

say_en: f: Good morning! It is seven o'clock. I wear my dress and my scarf. But where is my shoe?
show_en: Where is my shoe?

say_en: m: Look at Mina. How many shoes does she have?
show_en: How many shoes does she have?
wrong_say_fa: دوباره ببین. مینا فقط یک بوت دارد.

say_en: f: Is it on the bed? No. My pillow is on the bed. Is it in the box? No. My ball is in the box.
show_en: Is it on the bed? Is it in the box?

say_en: m: Where is the ball?
show_en: Where is the ball?
wrong_say_fa: دوباره ببین. توپ در صندوق است.

say_en: f: Look! The cat is under the table. What is next to the cat?
show_en: The cat is under the table.

say_en: m: What is next to the cat?
show_en: What is next to the cat?
wrong_say_fa: دوباره ببین. پهلوی پشک بوت مینا است.

say_en: f: Here is my shoe! Thank you, cat! Now I have two shoes.
show_en: Now I have two shoes.

say_en: f: I put on my shoes and I go to school. I am not late. Goodbye!
show_en: I put on my shoes and I go to school.
